outcome: serum levels of heat shock protein 27 (HSP27)
cohort: 50 newborns (25 healthy and 25 diagnosed with neonatal asphyxia) from Imam Reza Hospital, Mashhad, Iran
finding: Newborns with neonatal asphyxia had higher levels of HSP27 compared with healthy controls.
birth_weight: case group: 3110.47+/-613.5 g, control group: 3230.4+/-584.83 g
